config.description: Path to an Oxlint config file. Also disables nested config discovery.

fixSuggestions.description: Apply suggested fixes in addition to regular fixes.

tsconfig.description: Override the TypeScript config used for import resolution. Oxlint finds the relevant `tsconfig.json` for each file on its own, so this is only needed for a non-standard name or location. Type-aware linting ignores this and always discovers the config itself.

typeAware.description: Enable rules that require type information. Requires the `oxlint-tsgolint` package, which bundles its own TypeScript compiler.

disableNestedConfig.description: Disable nested config discovery. Oxlint resolves nested configs by default.
